settings.question: Will this feel like it's ripping my skin?
settings.answer: No — the film releases from the outer layer of dead skin and residue, not your live skin. Most users describe a light, satisfying tug rather than any pain.

settings.question: How often should I use it?
settings.answer: 1–2 times per week is ideal. Daily use isn't necessary since the formula works cumulatively and skin needs time to renew between peels.

settings.question: Is it safe for sensitive or acne-prone skin?
settings.answer: Yes — it's formulated without alcohol or synthetic fragrance and includes Centella Asiatica to keep the peel calming. We still recommend a patch test first.

settings.question: Can I use it around my eyes or on my lips?
settings.answer: Avoid the eye area, eyebrows, hairline, and lips — apply only to the cheeks, forehead, nose, and chin for best results.

settings.question: What if it doesn't peel off in one piece?
settings.answer: Make sure the layer is applied evenly and fully dried (it should look matte, not tacky) before peeling from the edges — a too-thin layer is the most common cause of tearing.

settings.question: How long does one jar last?
settings.answer: With 1–2 uses per week, a single jar typically lasts 6–8 weeks depending on how much product you apply per session.
